# 00000000221

**English.** Definition: The Perrin sequence is generated by the linear recurrence with characteristic polynomial x³ = x + 1; every prime p divides A_p, and composites satisfying the congruence are Perrin pseudoprimes. Conjecture: The count of Perrin pseudoprimes is X^{1/3+o(1)}; the exponent 1/3 is controlled by the weakest factor in the multiplicative sieve of cubic character roots, and the density of pseudoprimes among cubefree composites tends to zero at an explicit logarithmic-power rate. (Perrin pseudoprime counting law)

**中文。** 定义：Perrin 序列由特征多项式 x³=x+1 的线性递推生成，素数 p 满足 p 整除 A_p；满足同余的合数为 Perrin 伪素数。猜想：Perrin 伪素数的计数为 X^{1/3+o(1)}；指数 1/3 由三次特征根的乘性筛的最弱因子控制，且伪素数在立方自由合数中的密度沿 x 趋于零的速率为显式对数幂。（Perrin 伪素数计数律）
